data.summary: Synthetic demonstration analysis for headset-stand using demo-direct as of 2026-10-24. Target revenue margin 25% yields recommended price BRL 41.03. Without discount, charged price is BRL 41.03 with contribution BRL 10.2603 and revenue margin 25.01%. With a 10% discount, charged price falls to BRL 36.93 with contribution BRL 6.5703 and revenue margin 17.79%. The discount reduces but does not eliminate contribution; contribution remains positive, while the requested 25% revenue margin is not retained after discount.
assumptions: Product and rule are confirmed synthetic demonstration fixtures, not business-confirmed data.
Revenue charges are applied to revenue: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provisioning uses the stored synthetic failure rate and assumes a full-print retry on failure, with no additional overhead beyond stored costs.
Discount is modeled as a 10% reduction from the recommended price; no marketplace verification or extra promotions are included.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead may still exist beyond the stored cost fields.
Full-print retry assumption on failure may not match actual operations.
No current marketplace verification is available; the rule is synthetic demonstration data only.
Prices are drafts and require human approval; no publication or application is possible.
